fullDescription: A neo-brutalist acid-yellow landing hero on warm paper: 3px ink borders, hard offset shadows, an oversized boxed display headline with a highlighted keyword, and a rotated spec-card cluster, for AI/dev tools that want a bold print-poster look.

structured.summary: A neo-brutalist landing hero for an AI UI-generation tool, built on a warm paper canvas (#f4f1ea) with a faint ink grid texture, pure-black (#0a0a0a) 3px borders and offset hard drop shadows, and one electric acid-yellow accent (#e8ff00). The page reads as a confident print-poster: a sticky bordered nav, an oversized blocky display headline ('DESIGN AT THE SPEED OF A PROMPT') trapped inside a bordered paper block with a hard 12px shadow and the word 'speed' highlighted in an acid box, a blunt two-line subhead, mono supporting copy, two hard-shadow CTAs that physically press on hover/active, a mono trust strip, and a desktop-only cluster of three rotated 'spec cards' (prompt -> output -> canvas).

style.description: Neo-brutalist / acid-brutalist print aesthetic. Canvas is warm off-white paper (#f4f1ea) overlaid with a subtle 56px ink grid (linear-gradients at rgba(10,10,10,0.05)). Everything is built from three colors only: paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a (text + every border), and a single electric acid-yellow #e8ff00 accent used for the eyebrow pill, the 'speed' highlight box, the primary CTA, the period dot, and the middle spec card. There are NO soft shadows, gradients on surfaces, or rounded corners (except tiny pill dots): structure comes from crisp 3px solid ink borders and hard offset box-shadows (8px 8px 0 ink standard, 5px for small, 12px for the headline block). Type is a two-family system: Archivo (grotesk) in its heaviest weights (800/900) for the wordmark, headline and CTA labels, set tight (letter-spacing -0.04em, line-height 0.82 on the display), all uppercase; and JetBrains Mono for nav links, eyebrow, supporting body and trust strip, uppercase with wide tracking. The interaction signature is a tactile button press: hover translates the button up-left and grows the shadow, active slams it down-right and shrinks the shadow.
style.prompt: Design a neo-brutalist (acid-brutalist) hero on a warm paper canvas #f4f1ea with a faint 56px square grid drawn from rgba(10,10,10,0.05) gridlines. Restrict the palette to exactly three colors: paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a (used for ALL text and ALL borders), and one electric acid-yellow accent #e8ff00. Forbid soft shadows, surface gradients and rounded corners; build all structure from crisp 3px solid ink borders plus HARD offset drop shadows with no blur (box-shadow 8px 8px 0 0 #0a0a0a default, 5px 5px for small chips, 12px 12px for the headline block). Use a two-family type system: Archivo at weights 800/900 for the wordmark, the oversized uppercase display headline (letter-spacing -0.04em, line-height 0.82) and CTA labels; JetBrains Mono for nav links, the eyebrow pill, the mono supporting paragraph and the trust strip, all uppercase with wide letter-spacing (0.12em to 0.14em). Give buttons a tactile press micro-interaction: on hover translate(-2px,-2px) and grow the shadow to 10px 10px, on active translate(4px,4px) and shrink to 2px 2px, ~80ms ease. Keep the accent acid-yellow sparing: eyebrow pill, the 'speed' highlight box, the primary CTA, small square period/dot marks, and one of the spec cards.

layout_and_structure.description: Single full-bleed web hero, no device/browser frame. A sticky top nav (bordered, paper bg) sits above a grid-textured main. Content is centered to a max-w-[1180px] column with px-5/px-8 gutters. The hero is a two-column desktop grid: a flexible left content column and a fixed 300px right rail (minmax(0,1fr) 300px, gap-12, items-start). Left column flows top-to-bottom: acid eyebrow pill -> oversized headline inside a bordered paper block -> bold subhead -> mono supporting paragraph -> two stacked/inline CTAs -> mono trust strip. The right rail is a desktop-only (hidden below lg) decorative cluster of three rotated 'spec cards'. Below lg the right rail disappears and the headline scales fluidly (text-[16vw] -> 12.5vw -> fixed 102px), CTAs stack vertical-first.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top header (top-0, z-50), paper #f4f1ea background with a 3px bottom ink border. Inner row centered to max-w-[1180px], h-64px, space-between. Left: an uppercase Archivo-900 wordmark 'PROMPTSMITH' (20-22px, tight tracking) followed by a small 9px acid square with a 2px ink border nudged down ~6px (a brutalist 'dot'). Center (lg+ only): five JetBrains-Mono uppercase nav links (Library, Canvas, Skill, Pricing, Docs) at 13px medium with wide tracking, fading to ink/60 on hover. Right: a bordered 'Sign in' ghost link (2px ink border, paper fill, turns acid on hover; hidden on xs) and a solid-ink 'Start' button (paper text, flips to acid bg + ink text on hover), both mono uppercase 13px.

An inline-flex pill: acid #e8ff00 fill, 3px ink border, 5px 5px hard ink shadow, px-4 py-2. Inside: a 7px ink dot with a pulse animation, then JetBrains-Mono uppercase bold 12px text with 0.14em tracking, e.g. '2,400+ READY-TO-SHIP PROMPTS'.

Wrap the display headline in a paper #f4f1ea block with a 3px ink border and a big 12px 12px hard ink shadow, padded pl-5/pr-7/py-6 (more on sm). Inside, an Archivo-900 uppercase H1 set very tight (letter-spacing -0.04em, line-height 0.82) at a fluid size (text-[16vw] on mobile, 12.5vw on sm, fixed 102px on lg). Three lines: 'Design at' / 'the {speed}' / 'of a prompt{dot}'. The word 'speed' is wrapped in an inline acid box (acid fill, 3px ink border, 5px hard shadow, px-2/px-3). After 'prompt' add a small ~0.32em acid square with a 3px ink border as a period mark. The last line is whitespace-nowrap on sm+.

Below the headline, a bold Archivo-700 subhead, max-w-[600px], 24-30px, leading 1.12, tight tracking, blunt and punchy: 'Type a sentence. Get a real UI. No blank canvas, no tutorials, no excuses.' Under it, a JetBrains-Mono supporting paragraph, max-w-[540px], 14-15px, leading 1.7, color ink/80, explaining mockups/components/full layouts on an infinite canvas, a 2,400-prompt library, and driving it from a coding agent: 'It doesn't draw pictures of UI, it ships UI.'

A CTA row that is flex-col on mobile and flex-row on sm+, gap-4. Primary: acid #e8ff00 fill, 3px ink border, 8px hard ink shadow, px-7 py-4, Archivo-800 uppercase 16px label 'Generate a UI free' with a right-arrow icon (material-symbols:arrow-right-alt-rounded). Secondary: paper fill, 3px ink border, 8px hard ink shadow, same padding/type, a terminal icon (mdi:terminal) then 'Browse the library'. Both carry the tactile press micro-interaction (hover up-left + bigger shadow, active down-right + smaller shadow).

A wrapping mono trust strip, JetBrains-Mono uppercase 12px, 0.12em tracking, color ink/70, items separated by gap. Each item is a tiny 8px solid ink square followed by a label: 'No credit card', 'Claude Code & Cursor', 'Export to code'.

A fixed 300px right rail, hidden below lg, aria-hidden, a vertical flex of three rotated 'spec cards' (gap-7). Each card has a 3px ink border, 8px hard ink shadow, p-4, a JetBrains-Mono '// label' caption in the card's muted ink, and a value line. Card 1 (paper fill, rotate -1.5deg): '// prompt' + mono line 'a clean SaaS pricing page, 3 tiers, dark'. Card 2 (acid fill, rotate +1.5deg): '// output' + Archivo-800 uppercase 'check 12 screens · 0.8s' with a check-bold icon. Card 3 (ink fill, paper text, rotate -1deg): '// canvas' + acid-colored Archivo-800 uppercase 'infinite' with a vector-arrange icon.

special_ui_components.description: Depth is conveyed by solid, blur-less black drop shadows offset down-right, not soft blur. Three tiers: 5px (small chips/pills), 8px (cards/CTAs), 12px (the headline block). This is the defining brutalist device of the whole layout.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define three hard-shadow utilities, all zero-blur solid ink #0a0a0a: small = box-shadow 5px 5px 0 0, standard = 8px 8px 0 0, large = 12px 12px 0 0. Apply small to the eyebrow pill and the 'speed'/period boxes, standard to the CTAs and spec cards, large to the headline block. Never blur, never soften, never use a non-ink shadow color.

special_ui_components.description: Buttons feel like physical stamps: hovering lifts them up-left and grows the shadow; pressing slams them down-right and collapses the shadow, so the offset distance animates.
special_ui_components.prompt: On the CTA buttons add a transition on transform + box-shadow (~80ms ease). Default state has an 8px 8px hard ink shadow. On hover: transform translate(-2px,-2px) and box-shadow grows to 10px 10px 0 0 ink. On active: transform translate(4px,4px) and box-shadow shrinks to 2px 2px 0 0 ink, so the element appears pressed into the page.

special_ui_components.component: Boxed display headline with acid highlight
special_ui_components.description: The oversized uppercase headline lives inside its own bordered, hard-shadowed paper block, and a single word ('speed') is wrapped in an inline acid-yellow box to spike attention; a small acid square acts as the closing period.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set the H1 in Archivo-900 uppercase, letter-spacing -0.04em, line-height 0.82, fluid (16vw / 12.5vw / fixed 102px). Enclose the whole H1 in a paper block with a 3px ink border and a 12px hard ink shadow. Highlight one keyword by wrapping it in an inline-block acid #e8ff00 box with a 3px ink border, a 5px hard shadow and px-2/px-3 padding, baseline-aligned. End the headline with a small acid square (~0.32em, 3px ink border) as a period dot.

special_ui_components.description: A purely decorative desktop-only rail of three slightly rotated mono 'spec cards' (prompt -> output -> canvas) that narrate the product flow and add brutalist asymmetry; it disappears on tablet/mobile.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a desktop-only (hidden below lg, aria-hidden) 300px rail of three stacked cards, each with a 3px ink border and 8px hard ink shadow, rotated slightly differently (-1.5deg / +1.5deg / -1deg). Vary fills: paper, acid, ink (with paper/acid text). Each shows a JetBrains-Mono '// caption' label and a short value line, narrating prompt input -> generated output (with metric like '12 screens · 0.8s') -> infinite canvas. Hide the entire rail below lg.

structured.special_notes: FRAMELESS, responsive full-bleed web hero, not a screenshot inside device/browser chrome. Strictly three colors only: paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a (every text + every border), acid #e8ff00 (sparing accent); no other hues, no surface gradients, no rounded corners beyond tiny dots. Depth = 3px solid ink borders + hard zero-blur offset shadows (5/8/12px), never soft blur. Two fonts only: Archivo (weights 800/900, the display/wordmark/CTA labels, tight -0.04em tracking, line-height 0.82 on the H1) and JetBrains Mono (nav, eyebrow, body, trust strip, uppercase, wide tracking 0.12-0.14em). Background carries a faint 56px ink grid. Layout is a max-w-[1180px] centered column; the hero is a desktop two-column grid minmax(0,1fr) 300px with a desktop-only right spec-card rail (hidden below lg). The headline scales fluidly 16vw -> 12.5vw -> 102px; CTAs stack on mobile, inline on sm+. Buttons must keep the tactile press interaction. Icons via Iconify: material-symbols:arrow-right-alt-rounded, mdi:terminal, mdi:check-bold, mdi:vector-arrange-below.
